=== COMPOSE SERVICES (host) ===

observation.command:
echo "=== VERSION ==="; cat /workspace/VERSION
echo; echo "=== COMPOSE SERVICES (host) ==="
cd /workspace/.devcontainer/default && docker compose ps --format "table {{.Service}}\t{{.Status}}" 2>/dev/null
echo; echo "=== DEV CONTAINER processes ==="
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc 'ps aux | grep -E "forego start|puma 8|vite/bin|background-worker|websocket-server|dartsass|rails dartsass" | grep -v grep | wc -l; echo "dev procs running"'
echo; echo "=== Final HTTP checks ==="
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -lc '
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "ROOT=%{http_code}\n" --max-time 90 http://127.0.0.1:3000/
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "VITE_PROXY=%{http_code}\n" --max-time 60 "http://127.0.0.1:3000/assets/frontend/vite-dev/@vite/client"
echo "app title:"; curl -s --max-time 30 http://127.0.0.1:3000/ | grep -o "<title>[^<]*</title>"'
